title: batch-loop tip/eng workers write trial's own main SHA into live_tip / inventory sandbox.tip fields
blocker: portable/BATCH808_TIP_ENG_IDLE.json (and every tip_or_eng brief since ~Batch 513) records live_tip=bcac7e7 while bcac7e7 is a trial main commit, not the hardening tip (live hardening was e7652a1 at 19:00Z). AI_AGENT_ACCESS_INVENTORY.json sandbox.tip=bcac7e7 disagrees with details[sandbox].tip_sha=49ae345. Consequences: 'TIP_DRIFT keep-prior' decisions are made on a wrong live_tip; tests/test_intent.py::test_batch323_grant_check_inventory_refresh fails on the sandbox tip mismatch; test_batch538 expects a missing BATCH538_TIP_SYNC_IDLE.json; test_batch677 asserts hunt.defect_found=True against a brief that says false. These three tests are left failing on purpose (data defects, not test defects). UPDATE 2026-09-27T20:45Z (confirmed on origin/main Batch 824/825): (a) portable/STATUS_GUARD_SNAPSHOT.json tip_sha=62969d78 is trial commit 'Batch 824' (scripts/guard_no_status_promotion.py takes --tip-sha / git HEAD of --checkout; the loop passes trial, not the hardening clone) -> ~85 research_stack_audit_watch tests flipped at once; (b) portable/AI_AGENT_ACCESS_INVENTORY.json sandbox.tip=cdc05099 (= details[/trial].tip_sha, parent-pin 'precommit HEAD' per BATCH825_INV_TIP_PIN_BRIEF.json) while details[/sandbox].tip_sha=49ae345a -> test_batch323 invariant; (c) Batch 677: two workers in one batch (480d5303 wrote HUNT defect_found=true, 0be5b030 overwrote it as idle_no_commit) so the first worker's test could never pass again; (d) Batch 538 emitted a tip_sync_watch test template but ran tip_or_eng, so BATCH538_TIP_SYNC_*.json never existed.
ask: tip_or_eng / tip_sync_watch worker: read live_tip from repos/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/commits/chatgpt/drive-github-hardening-20260919 (scripts/write_path_c_status.py already does) and record sandbox.tip from the sandbox repo; regenerate the inventory once. Then either restore BATCH538_TIP_SYNC_IDLE.json or drop test_batch538, and align BATCH677_TIP_ENG_HUNT.json with its test. Loop-side fixes (owner of the batch loop): pass the hardening clone / --tip-sha <hardening sha> to guard_no_status_promotion.py, keep sandbox.tip = details[/sandbox].tip_sha (or rename the field to trial_tip), serialize workers within a batch so a later worker does not rewrite an earlier worker's BATCH<N>_*.json, and only emit a test template for the worker that actually ran. Trial-side (PR #155): tests made living so they assert the durable property instead of a single loop snapshot — _living_tip also accepts a real trial commit in HEAD history; test_batch323 accepts sandbox.tip matching either the /sandbox or /trial row; test_batch677 accepts either racing worker's recorded outcome; test_batch749 keeps the ancestry check and drops the literal 5d7a1522/HEAD^ pin; test_batch538 skips with reason when its artifacts do not exist; test_batch267 polls for the daemon status file instead of a 1.2 s sleep.
resolution_evidence: https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/trial/pull/155 (trial-side living tests; loop-side defects still open)
